# Comparisons

This folder contains comparative analyses of clinical quality indicators, epidemiological trends, and patient outcomes for atrial fibrillation in Denmark, drawn from the AFDK annual reports. It covers regional and national performance on treatment timelines, diagnostic procedures, and pharmacological monitoring, alongside the incidence of complications like ischemic stroke, intracranial hemorrhage, and heart failure. Additionally, it details geographical disparities in disease prevalence, risk score distributions, and specific coding frameworks used in the national registries.
